title: 第17章 后门是应该的？！
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
灵脉矿的灵气浓郁得像雾一样，月光透过灵气雾霭洒下来，染上一层淡淡的银白色。

    顾念念躺在床上，灵气像是有自我意识一样，不断地往她的身体里钻。

    在她的身体上也形成了一层淡淡的光芒。

    但她却睡得深沉，毫无知觉。

    桃夭绕着顾念念的身体晃了两圈，声音里满是欢喜。

    “按照这个速度，主人再有几天又能升阶了。”

    刚说完，一转身，就看到了小灰。

    桃夭更高兴了。

    “小灰，你也能出来了？”

    小灰木着脸躲开了它的靠近，灵体直接飘到了顾念念的旁边。

    小灰看着顾念念睡着却依旧不太开怀的脸，眼底多了一丝淡淡的情绪。

    “你今天差点害了她。”

    此话一出，原本又要欢快冲上来的桃夭立刻停住了身体，转而躲在了帷幔后，期期艾艾地说道：“我不是故意的，我以后都不会了。”

    小灰的声音依旧冷漠，却压迫感十足。

    “没有以后。”

    他转过身。

    “你知不知道，今天她差点就要动用那股力量了。她已经沉睡了，如今主人的身体还撑不住这股力量，一旦使用，她自己的身体最先会崩溃。”

    “你觉得以她现在练气五层的修为，肉身崩溃后，修仙路还能顺利吗？”

    桃夭耷拉着剑身，一句话也说不出来了。

    小灰没再说什么。

    “化神前，不能让她动用这个力量。”

    桃夭立刻抬起头。

    “我会保护好主人的，我发誓。”

    小灰深深地看了它一眼，随后身体在空气中瞬间消失不见。

    桃夭大松一口气，飘回顾念念的身边，安安静静地躺在她的怀里，再也不跳脱了。

    一夜无梦。

    第二日清晨，顾念念是被一阵嘈杂声吵醒的。

    外面有人在喊，声音里带着怒气。

    “萧易水！这条矿脉的产量足足少了三成，你跟我说不可抗力，怎么个不可抗力，你不交代清楚，你让我怎么跟上面去交代？”

    “你是不是存心要让我在宗门里被责罚？”

    紧跟着是顾念念昨天听到的那个十分冷淡的声音。

    她知道那是萧易水。

    “李师兄想多了，这条灵脉已经存在多年，日日被开采，产量走低本就是常态，宗门也是知道的。”
content_en:
The spiritual energy of the spiritual vein mine is as rich as mist, and the moonlight shines through the mist of spiritual energy, dyeing it with a light silvery white color.

    Gu Niannian was lying on the bed, and the spiritual energy continued to penetrate into her body as if it had self-awareness.

    A faint light also formed on her body.

    But she slept deeply and unconsciously.

    Taoyao circled around Gu Niannian's body twice, her voice full of joy.

    "At this rate, Master will be able to advance to another level in a few days."

    As soon as he finished speaking, he turned around and saw Xiao Hui.

    Taoyao was even happier.

    "Xiao Hui, can you come out too?"

    Xiao Hui dodged its approach with a wooden face, and the spirit body floated directly to Gu Niannian's side.

    Xiao Hui looked at Gu Niannian's sleeping but still unhappy face, and there was a hint of emotion in his eyes.

    "You almost killed her today."

    As soon as these words came out, Taoyao, who was about to rush forward happily, immediately stopped and hid behind the curtain. She said calmly: "I didn't mean it, and I won't do it anymore."

    Xiao Hui's voice was still cold, but full of pressure.

    "There is no future."

    He turned around.

    "Do you know that she almost used that power today. She has already fallen asleep, and now the master's body cannot support this power. Once used, her own body will collapse first."

    "Do you think that with her current level of cultivation at the fifth level of qi training, after her physical body collapses, her path to immortality will still be smooth?"

    Tao Yao drooped her sword and couldn't say a word.

    Xiao Hui said nothing more.

    "She cannot be allowed to use this power before she transforms into a god."

    Taoyao immediately raised her head.

    "I will protect my master, I swear."

    Xiao Hui took a deep look at it, and then his body disappeared in the air instantly.

    Tao Yao breathed a sigh of relief, drifted back to Nian Nian, and lay quietly in her arms, never jumping away again.

    A dreamless night.

    In the early morning of the next day, Gu Niannian was awakened by a burst of noise.

    Someone was shouting outside, with anger in their voice.

    "Xiao Yishui! The output of this mine has been reduced by 30%. You told me about force majeure. What kind of force majeure? If you don't explain it clearly, how do you want me to explain it to the superiors?"

    "Are you intentionally wanting me to be punished in the sect?"

    Followed by the very cold voice that Gu Niannian heard yesterday.

    She knew it was Xiao Yishui.

    "Senior Brother Li is overthinking this spiritual vein. This spiritual vein has existed for many years and has been mined every day. It is normal for the output to be low, and the sect also knows it."
title_en: Chapter 17 Is the back door necessary? !
